text:
Aisha Rivera: Drafting outbound for impacted onboarding customers (SMB + midmarket) after yesterday's ingestion hiccup. Want quick review before we send at 11:30 PT.
Priya Nair: thanks — can you paste the short status + ask we want in the subject line?
Aisha Rivera: Subject: "Important: Onboarding sync delay — next steps and office hours"
Marco Chen: TL;DR root cause for CS: an S3 credential rotation hit the ingest webhook retry window; some payloads were dropped during a 45m window. Engineering has a safe-replay utility for failed batches.
Jon Patel: Suggested customer-facing one-liner: "We encountered a transient onboarding sync failure; we’ve reprocessed affected records and are offering hands-on help plus a credit for affected customers."
Priya Nair: thanks. what's our standard credit? small accounts get $50, midmarket $250?
Aisha Rivera: propose $50 trial top-up for SMBs, $250 for midmarket, and a personalized onboarding session (30m) for anyone flagged as renewal-risk this quarter.
Marco Chen: confirmation from eng: replays completed for 85% of impacted jobs. Remaining ~15% require customer opt-in because we need permission to re-send source files. We can provide an export for them to re-upload.
Jon Patel: good call. We'll ask permission in the email and include a short one-click flow to schedule the guided re-ingest office hour. Use this Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood-cs/replay-office-hour
Aisha Rivera: here's the draft email body — please skim for tone and missing asks:

```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We’re reaching out with an update about a transient onboarding outage that affected some account imports between 03/10 09:20–10:05 UTC. The issue: an internal credential rotation briefly rejected webhook retries, which caused a subset of ingest batches to fail.

What we did: engineering completed automated replays for ~85% of the affected batches. For the remaining batches we can either reprocess on your behalf (we'll need permission to retrieve and resend your source files) or provide an export you can re-upload.

What we’re offering:
• A one-time account credit of $50 (SMB) / $250 (midmarket).
• A complimentary 30-minute onboarding session to walk through the re-ingest and validation steps. Book here: [scheduling link].

If you’d like us to reprocess on your behalf, reply with "Please reprocess" and we’ll get started. If you prefer an export, reply with "Please export" and we’ll send a download.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. We’ve added additional retry guards and a brief hold during credential rotations to prevent this happening again. If this incident has impacted an upcoming renewal conversation, let us know and we’ll connect you directly with your CS/Success Manager.

— The Redwood CS Team
```

Priya Nair: copy looks good. Suggest adding a short bullet on how we validated replays (checksums + sample validation against expected counts). Also add a direct support link for urgent cases.
Aisha Rivera: updated line: "Replays were validated via checksums and record-count sampling; we’ll share a short validation summary after reprocessing. For urgent needs reach support@redwood.ai"
Marco Chen: addendum from eng: we’ve deployed a retry-safety guard that pauses retries during credential rotations and emits an alert to ops; ETA for full rollout across regions is 48h.
Jon Patel: operational asks for this thread:
1) Priya — approve credit bands (SMB/midmarket) by 11:00 PT.
2) Aisha — final send and segmentation (list of accounts impacted + renewal flag).
3) Marco — confirm replay ETA for the remaining 15% and send validation summary to customers when done.
Priya Nair: approved.
Aisha Rivera: segmentation note: I’ll target the outbound to 72 impacted tenants (43 SMB, 29 midmarket). I’ll flag the 8 accounts with upcoming renewals for the GM handoff.
CS-Bot: Incident Redwood-2026-03-10: ingestion-webhook-failure resolved and post-incident task created (INC-9876).
Jon Patel: thanks. Aisha — can you post the final email and send time here before sending? I’ll cc growth to make sure billing applies credits.
Aisha Rivera: will do. Planning send at 11:28 PT, will paste final copy + recipient counts here for review at 11:20 PT.
Priya Nair: also capture customer feedback via this quick form after the office hour: https://forms.redwood.ai/cs/post-incident-feedback — include link in the follow-up validation email.
Marco Chen: replay ETA for remaining batches: 6h from now. I’ll attach the validation report when available.
Aisha Rivera: perfect — thanks team. sending draft for last pass in 10m.
Jon Patel: :thumbsup:
